activity_statements.statement: builds, owns, and operates 45+ rental senior living communities across 8 East Coast states providing independent living, assisted living, and memory care
delivers Wellspring Village dementia and Alzheimer's memory care neighborhoods within its senior living communities
provides residents with daily care services, chef-prepared meals, transportation, and wellness programming (SPICE model) in a rental format with no large entrance fee
develops and acquires new senior living community sites, having invested more than $2 billion in senior housing development

name_reality_gap: Indexed as 'Hospitality' — partially true in that hospitality-style amenities are part of the model, but the primary activity is residential senior care including assisted living and dementia care requiring nursing and clinical staffing, not a conventional hospitality operation.
extraction_notes: About page was detailed and concrete. Rental model (no entrance fee) is a notable business model distinction from other senior living operators.
